entities.name: Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Muttalib
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib was the father of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. He was the son of Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim and Fatima bint Amr of the Makhzum Clan.
